categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in semiconductor specialized equipment, focusing on four main business segments: front-end coating and developing equipment, front-end cleaning equipment, back-end advanced packaging equipment, and compound semiconductor small-size equipment. These products cover front-end wafer processing, back-end advanced packaging, and compound semiconductor fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced coating and developing techniques, high-precision cleaning technologies (chemical and physical), temporary bonding and debonding for advanced packaging, and SiC wafer dicing technology using proprietary SnB dicing. The company emphasizes high process coverage, stability, cleanliness, and high throughput, with equipment capable of inline operation with lithography machines and meeting advanced process nodes (28nm and above).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international semiconductor manufacturers in logic, memory, power devices, and advanced packaging sectors, including TSMC, SMIC, Hua Tian Technology, and others. The company serves semiconductor wafer fabs and packaging/test facilities, targeting markets in integrated circuit manufacturing and compound semiconductor production.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenyang and Shanghai, and subsidiaries in Guangzhou and Japan. Its sales and service network covers major semiconductor industry clusters in the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Taiwan region, with growing overseas customer orders, especially in advanced packaging.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying critical front-end and back-end semiconductor processing equipment. It also develops key components like photoresist pumps, enhancing its vertical integration within the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening R&D in front-end coating and developing, chemical and physical cleaning, advanced packaging temporary bonding/debonding, and SiC dicing technologies. The company invests heavily in innovation to achieve international advanced levels, accelerate domestic substitution of foreign equipment, and expand product lines to cover emerging Chiplet and 2.5D/3D packaging technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of semiconductor specialized equipment, including coating/developing machines and wet processing equipment. Additional income comes from sales of related parts, maintenance services, and after-sales technical support. The company primarily uses a direct sales model supplemented by authorized agents in specific regions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a domestic leader in coating/developing and single-wafer wet processing equipment, successfully breaking foreign monopolies in several product categories. It competes with international giants like ASML, TEL, and SCREEN in high-end lithography-related equipment, and with domestic peers in advanced packaging equipment. Its growing product portfolio and technology advances position it strongly in China's semiconductor equipment market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.75 billion, a 2.13% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 203 million, down 19.08%. Total assets reached RMB 5.6 billion, up 30.11%, and net assets RMB 2.69 billion, up 13.05%. R&D investment increased significantly to RMB 297 million, accounting for 16.92% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth and innovation focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high process coverage, stability, cleanliness, and throughput in its equipment, with unique capabilities such as inline operation with lithography machines and advanced temporary bonding/debonding solutions for Chiplet packaging. It offers competitive domestic alternatives to foreign-dominated markets, with strong customer recognition for product reliability, cost-effectiveness, and tailored solutions for advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes.
